name: Warden Ptolemy

intro.text: The Enclosure will 'curate' the Shambles. Make it straight. Tidy the lean. Cut the crooked bits. I've a spirit level.

win: My spirit level has a crack in it. My spirit does too.
after: The crooked houses lean because they're old. Our boss calls them 'a hazard'. I call them lovely and I'm not telling him.
